name: Sauroplites
isnote: Bohlin placed it in Ankylosauridae; Arbour 2014 recovered it as a nodosaurid, Rivera-Sylva et al. 2018 in a clade of basal nodosaurids; placed in Ankylosauria.
sum: Sauroplites is an Early Cretaceous armoured dinosaur from China with a sacral shield of rosettes, known from specimens now lost.
holotype: Specimens without inventory numbers, now lost although casts are preserved (cited revision).
material: Fragmentary remains with a sacral shield of rosettes.
biology: Known only from armour and fragments; no behavioural data.
author: Bohlin 1953

sources.text: B. Bohlin. 1953. VI. Vertebrate Palaeontology 6. Fossil reptiles from Mongolia and Kansu. Reports from the Scientific Expedition to the North-western Provinces of China under Leadership of Dr. Sven Hedin. The Sino-Swedish Expedition Publication 37:1-113
